# sendgrid_domain_authentication (Resource)

Manages a SendGrid authenticated sending domain (Domain Authentication, formerly "domain whitelabeling"). After creating this resource, create the DNS records it reports in `dns_records` with your DNS provider; SendGrid validates them asynchronously.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sendgrid_domain_authentication" "example" {
  domain             = "example.com"
  automatic_security = true
  default            = true
}

# After creating this resource, create the DNS records it reports with your
# DNS provider. SendGrid validates them asynchronously.
output "sendgrid_dns_records" {
  value = sendgrid_domain_authentication.example.dns_records
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The domain being authenticated.

### Optional

- `automatic_security` (Boolean) Whether SendGrid automatically manages this domain's SPF record and DKIM key rotation. If omitted, SendGrid's own default is used and read back into state after creation.
- `custom_dkim_selector` (String) A custom three-character DKIM selector.
- `custom_spf` (Boolean) Whether to use a custom SPF record instead of the one SendGrid manages. Only available for domains set up for manual security (`automatic_security = false`).
- `default` (Boolean) Whether to use this as the fallback authenticated domain when no other authenticated domain matches a sender's domain.
- `ips` (List of String) IP addresses to include in this domain's custom SPF record. Only used when `custom_spf` is `true` and `automatic_security` is `false`.
- `region` (String) The region of the domain: `global` or `eu`. Defaults to `global`.
- `subdomain` (String) The subdomain to use for this authenticated domain's DNS records.
- `username` (String) Associates this authenticated domain with a subuser's username, allowing that subuser to see and modify it.

### Read-Only

- `dns_records` (Map of String) The DNS records to create with your DNS provider, flattened to `"<record>_type"`, `"<record>_host"`, and `"<record>_data"` keys for `mail_cname`, `dkim1`, and `dkim2`.
- `id` (String) The authenticated domain's numeric ID.
- `valid` (Boolean) Whether SendGrid has validated the required DNS records for this domain.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sendgrid_domain_authentication.example <domain_id>
```
